faq_heading: Homes near Maddaugh Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Maddaugh Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Maddaugh Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Maddaugh Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Maddaugh Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 161 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,480,000, townhomes $838,500, condos $474,950. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Maddaugh Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Maddaugh Elementary the median was 23 days on the market, closing at 97.3% of the list price, with 6% of sales above the list price for the 161 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Maddaugh Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Hazelgrove Elementary (1.3 km south-west), Katzie Elementary (1.3 km south) and Regent Road Elementary (1.5 km west).

Maddaugh Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 19405 76 Ave. It teaches grades K to 7.
Use the search below to see homes for sale that name Maddaugh Elementary in the listing, then check the sold prices within 1 km of the school.
How the Maddaugh Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Maddaugh Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Maddaugh Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 161 homes sold within 1 km of Maddaugh Elementary: 38 houses, 73 townhomes and 10 condos. The largest group was townhomes, at a median of $838,500.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Maddaugh Elementary

16 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Maddaugh Elementary in a straight line (11 elementary, 3 secondary, 1 middle, 1 other; 1 independent). The closest is Hazelgrove Elementary, 1.3 km away, and the farthest on this list is Adams Road Elementary, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is R E Mountain Secondary (1.6 km); the nearest independent school is Crescent Heights Academy (2.4 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Ecole Salish Secondary (2.1 km). Other elementary schools close by: Hazelgrove Elementary (1.3 km south-west), Katzie Elementary (1.3 km south), Regent Road Elementary (1.5 km west), R C Garnett Demonstration Elementary (1.9 km south-east), Josette Dandurand Elementary (2.0 km north-east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Hazelgrove Elementary, 1.3 km south-west of Maddaugh Elementary.
